_fixture_note: MG-23 destroy circuit-breaker fixture — AN ACTION VERB THIS GATE DOES NOT KNOW. Stands in for a future Terraform release introducing a new action. The gate classifies only `no-op`, `create`, `read` and `update` as benign; everything else is PROTECTED under its own verb. Fail-closed means an unrecognized verb BLOCKS the apply (exit 1, a verdict) — it does not mean the change falls through unclassified into a green run, and it does not mean an unreadable-plan exit 2 that no override can clear. It is ALSO NOT OVERRIDABLE: a verb outside the modeled set (no-op, create, read, update, delete, forget) cannot be classified, so the gate cannot describe what applying it would do and will not present it for review — TF_DESTROY_GUARD_AUTHORIZED_CHANGES cannot clear it, and an override naming `obliterate:<addr>` must still exit 1.
